title: Typo in the label: "Email adress"
hint: Read every field label letter by letter.
explanation: "Address" is missing a "d". Typos in the interface make the product look careless and erode trust.

title: Email accepts an address without a top-level domain (a@b)
hint: Try an address with no dot after the @.
explanation: The regex only checks for an @. An address like a@b is not deliverable, so the confirmation email never arrives.

title: Hint says "at least 6 characters", the error says 8
hint: Compare the hint under the password field with the error message.
explanation: The hint and the error name different rules. The user cannot tell which one is real.

title: A 3-character password passes validation
explanation: The check is length < 3, while the requirement is at least 8 characters.

title: The password is logged to the browser console in plain text
hint: Open DevTools and submit the form.
explanation: On submit the whole payload, password included, goes to console.log. Passwords must never end up in logs.

title: The "Create account" button is shifted right and out of line with the fields
hint: Look at how the left edges of the form elements line up.
explanation: The button has an extra margin-left: 13px, so its right edge sticks out of the form grid.

title: A double click creates two accounts
hint: What happens if you press the button several times while the request is in flight?
explanation: The button is not disabled while submitting, and the duplicate check runs against a stale list. Every click creates an account.

title: The "Phone" label is not connected to its field
hint: Click the name of every field.
explanation: The label's for attribute points to an id that does not exist. Clicking the label does not focus the field and screen readers do not announce its name.

title: Phone accepts letters and invalid numbers
hint: Enter something into the phone field that is not a phone number.
explanation: The field is only checked for being non-empty. The +375 number format is never validated.

title: Date of birth accepts a date that does not exist (31/02)
explanation: The day is only checked against the 1-31 range, ignoring the month and leap years.

title: Sign-up succeeds without accepting the terms
explanation: The terms checkbox is never checked on submit, although sign-up is not allowed without consent.

title: Real names with accents or apostrophes are rejected (José, O'Connor)
hint: Not everyone's name fits into A-Z.
explanation: The regex allows only the Latin letters A-Z. The service turns away users with perfectly normal names.

title: Typing a date of birth throws errors in the console
hint: Open DevTools and keep an eye on the Console while you type a date.
explanation: An analytics call converts every keystroke into a date. A half-typed value like 1/0 is an Invalid Date, so toISOString throws "RangeError: Invalid time value". Uncaught errors in the console are bugs even when the UI looks fine: here the analytics event is never sent.

title: On phones the terms label is cut off
hint: Read every label on a narrow phone screen. DevTools device mode works too.
explanation: Below 480px the label gets white-space: nowrap and overflow: hidden, so "I agree to the terms of service and the privacy policy" ends mid-word. The user agrees to something they cannot read. Long labels must wrap.
